pro_course_detail.description:
Hello and welcome to our Conversational English lessons! My goal is to help you speak English with confidence and clarity, especially in professional settings like business meetings.

What You Can Expect from My Lessons:
	1.	Personalized Learning – Each lesson is designed to fit your needs, focusing on areas where you need the most improvement.
	2.	Real-Life Conversations – We will practice dialogues and discussions that you would encounter in business and everyday situations.
	3.	Confidence Building – I will guide you with techniques to speak naturally and comfortably in English.
	4.	Pronunciation & Fluency – You will improve your pronunciation and learn how to speak more smoothly.
	5.	Grammar & Vocabulary in Context – Instead of memorizing rules, you will learn grammar and new words through practical conversation.
	6.	Constructive Feedback – I will provide corrections and suggestions to help you improve continuously.

How Our Lessons Will Work:
	•	Each session will be interactive and engaging.
	•	We will use role-plays, discussions, and real-world scenarios.
	•	You will receive practice exercises to reinforce what you’ve learned.

By the end of our lessons, you will feel more confident, natural, and fluent in English, ready to handle any business conversation with ease.

I’m excited to start this journey with you! Let me know if you have any specific goals or areas you’d like to focus on.
